description: Points de signalisation lumineuse tricolore & Supports is a dataset listed in Gpseo open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GPS&O. Emplacements des points de signalisation lumineuse tricolore. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine et Oise. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are voirie, slt, support, signalisation. The portal shows 2,264 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License Version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gpseo-portal.
